legs.weather_status: Indoor arena; weather not a factor.
legs.evidence: New Orleans is on the second night of a back-to-back after losing 142-111 at home to Memphis last night. That was its fifth straight loss, following a 145-111 home loss to Brooklyn. ESPN standings: Pelicans 4-9, -9.1 differential. Denver is 6-4 (3-2 on the road), has not played since winning 123-118 at Memphis on Wednesday with Jokic (27 pts) and Murray (30) playing, and its only non-two-way absence on the official 8:15 AM report is Julian Strawther (knee). The Pelicans' 1:15 PM report lists Trey Murphy III (patellar tendinopathy), Dejounte Murray (ankle), Trendon Watford (ankle) and Bryce McGowens (elbow) OUT, with Yves Missi listed AVAILABLE on the 6:15 PM report.
legs.remaining_checks: Counterevidence and open items: Denver's differential is only +1.2 and it lost 110-100 at Houston on Tuesday. Jokic/Murray participation is not officially confirmed beyond being absent from the report. Starters not confirmed. Live PA/MD price not checked.
legs.lineup_status: Official 6:15 PM ET NBA report: Nuggets' Strawther OUT (knee), plus G League/two-way Holmes II, Nembhard, Whitmore OUT. Pelicans: Murphy III, Murray, Watford, McGowens OUT; Missi now AVAILABLE (was probable); two-way Dia, Reese, Pierre Jr. AVAILABLE. Starters not confirmed.

legs.weather_status: Indoor arena; weather not a factor.
legs.evidence: Chicago is on the second night of a back-to-back after a 125-117 overtime home win over Atlanta last night (Okoro 41 min, Giddey 39). ESPN standings: Bulls 2-9, 1-5 on the road, -13.3 differential. Minnesota is 9-3 (5-1 at home), +13.4 differential, has won five straight and has had a day off since beating Dallas 133-94 on Thursday — a game Anthony Edwards and Donte DiVincenzo did not play in, so their absences are not new. The Bulls' 1:15 PM report lists Caleb Wilson (metacarpal fracture) and Tobe Awaka OUT, with Nic Claxton, Norman Powell and Jalen Smith QUESTIONABLE.
legs.remaining_checks: Counterevidence and open items: Anthony Edwards (knee arthroscopy) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles) are OUT. Bulls' Claxton, Powell and J. Smith are questionable, so Chicago's lineup is unsettled. -1100 pays very little. Live PA/MD price not checked.
legs.lineup_status: Official 6:15 PM ET NBA report: Timberwolves' Edwards and DiVincenzo OUT, Beringer AVAILABLE (face mask). Bulls: C. Wilson, Awaka OUT (Sellers, Swain G League); Claxton, Powell, J. Smith still QUESTIONABLE. Starters not confirmed.
